answer.why: The video opens on a terminal and spends roughly 8 seconds on training logs before the MuJoCo simulation appears, which caps wow and clarity at 4. Captions in the final card are large and legible, but the robot ends collapsed on the ground rather than walking confidently, undercutting the payoff. Visual quality is decent but the long terminal preamble and ambiguous final pose hurt overall craft.
fixes: Open on the robot already walking successfully in the MuJoCo sim, then cut to training details second
Add a visible reward curve or pass/fail badge from the independent judge so viewers know the policy actually worked
Trim the terminal section to 2-3 s maximum and overlay a progress bar or epoch counter instead of raw logs
Show the robot's pose progression (fall → stand → walk) in a short montage rather than near-static camera
End on the robot walking smoothly, not collapsed, so the last impression is success
